# 📊 Better and reproducible scripts with R Markdown

## From raw script to functional: R Markdown {.center}

::::::::: columns
:::::::: {.column width="55%"}
::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}
**1. Create the file** 📄 <br><small>Go to **New File \> R Markdown**.
This moves you from raw code to a "living" document.</small>
:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="2"}
**2. Configure (YAML)** ⚙️ <br><small>The header between `---` controls
your title, author, and output format (HTML/PDF).</small>
:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="3"}
**3. Text + Code chunks** 📝 <br><small>Write text normally; insert
**Code Chunks** (`{r}`) for analysis.</small>
:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="4"}
**4. Run your codes** ▶️ <br><small>Use the green **Play Button** to
test individual steps.</small>
:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="5"}
**5. The final "Knit"** 🧶 <br><small>Click **Knit** to stitch
everything into a polished report automatically!</small>
:::
::::::::

## 😱 Common problem

When you try to knit your R Markdown document into a PDF file, you may
encounter this message:

``` r
sh: pdflatex: command not found

Error: LaTeX failed to compile Untitled.tex. See The R package tinytex - Helper Functions to Manage TinyTeX, and Compile LaTeX Documents - Yihui Xie | 谢益辉 for debugging tips. See Untitled.log for more info.
In addition: Warning message:
In system2(..., stdout = if (use_file_stdout()) f1 else FALSE, stderr = f2) :
error in running command
Execution halted
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The solution

You need to install a package before creating the PDF document.

Here are the steps:

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}
**1. Run this line of code in the console block:**

``` r
tinytex::install_tinytex()
```

It can take some time, up to 5 minutes.
:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="2"}
**2. Click one more time on "Knit to PDF"**

It's supposed to work. If it still doesn't work, please contact me!
:::
